build_genomics_ood_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset builder for genomics out-of-distribution detection with 130 bacteria classes
create_genomics_ood_builder: create a GenomicsOod dataset builder inheriting from tfds.core.GeneratorBasedBuilder with train and OOD splits
test_genomics_ood_info: test the GenomicsOod dataset info including features seq, label, seq_info, and domain
review_genomics_ood_splits: review the GenomicsOod _split_generators method that defines train, validation, test, validation_ood, and test_ood splits
summarize_genomics_ood_generate: summarize the GenomicsOod _generate_examples method that reads tab-separated CSV files and yields seq, label, seq_info, domain examples
